components.description: A finite family of dominated models
components.notes: Definition supplies labels, standard Borel spaces, model likelihoods and priors, m_k, Q_k, model priors, mixture density, domain G, weights and Bayes factors with zero-denominator conventions. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

Annex proves m_k measurability/normalization, Q_alpha(G)=1, conditional model probabilities via tagged union, joint model-parameter posterior, odds identity, reciprocity/log identity and the 1/6 example; source odds form Kass-Raftery Sec.3.1 and evidence scales Sec.3.2 verified. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Density versions, reference measures and parameter coordinates
components.notes: Annex proves version invariance a.e., intrinsic RN densities r_k with Q_* and uniqueness, reference-measure change, parameter transport, observation bijection transport and null-point example. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

Annex proves kernel disintegration identity by pi-lambda, iterated marginal, sup bound, and the finite profile-reversal example (5/6 vs 3/2, .1+.8 beta); source eq.(13) discussion. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.
Annex completes the square with constants, gives m_0, m_1, B_01, centered form, and full-sample reduction via common factor. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Prior scale, normal-class bounds and limiting paths
components.notes: Annex proves r limits, sup over normal variances with argmax, mixtures bound, point-prior sup exp(z^2/2), and both n-paths limits. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: The same standardized observation under different priors
components.notes: Table values given exact expressions in annex lines 255-262 (verified numerically: .5203/.3422, .4463/.3086, .5227/.3433, 1.3807/.5800, 4.2882/.8109). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.
Definition supplies common-quantity kernels, meaning constraints and mixture kernel with exceptional-data default. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Mixture laws and total posterior variance
components.notes: Annex proves kernel property, integration identity, both variance forms (source form eqs.(17)-(19)), between-model term sign, and both selection examples. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Preserving prior mass when a label is split
components.notes: Annex proves prior-odds multiplier, label-split invariance a.e., and the 9/10 and 18/19 examples. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

Annex proves scaling of Z_k, infinite total mass, common-constant cancellation limits, flat-normal example, proper uniform bound, and the two conditional versions at psi=1/2 giving .2 and .8. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

Annex proves finite-sum marginal and weights, common-factor cancellation, model-factor non-cancellation, log-sum-exp identity, binomial example 16/25 and 16/41, normal-constant counterexample. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: A calibrated null-tail statistic need not equal posterior model probability
components.notes: Annex proves exact uniformity of the null tail statistic, z=2 value, invariance to priors, w_0->1 on fixed-z path, and the contrasting fixed-departure path. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.
